out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND SINKS MUST ALWAYS BE STOCKED WITH HAND SOAP SO EMPLOYEES CAN ALWAYS WASH THEIR HANDS TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF BACTERIA. MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN FOR HOTEL CAME TO REFILL HAND SOAP.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the only hand sink in the kitchen being used to store a red sanitizer bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE USED FOR ANYTHING BESIDES HAND WASHING. PIC REMOVED SANITIZER BUCKET FROM THE HAND SINK AND PLACED IT UNDER A PREP TABLE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC ORDERED A HIGH TEMP DISH MACHINE THERMOMETER BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION. PIC SHOWED EHS THE INVOICE FOR THE THERMOMETER.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. PIC ORDERED QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION. PIC SHOWED EHS THE INVOICE FOR THE TEST KIT.
